en.title: EXIF Remover — Coding.Tools
en.description: Remove EXIF metadata from images online to protect your privacy. Free and runs in your browser.
en.toolDescription: Strip all EXIF metadata from your images including GPS location, camera info, and personal data.
en.dropzoneMessage: Click or drag images here to upload
descParas: This tool removes all EXIF metadata from your images by re-encoding them through the Canvas API. GPS coordinates, camera information, timestamps, and all other metadata are stripped.
The tool processes images entirely in your browser. No files are uploaded to a server.
steps: Drag and drop images onto the upload area, or click to select files.
Each image is processed and all EXIF metadata is removed.
Download individual cleaned images or use Download All to get a ZIP archive.
whatIsParas: Photos taken with smartphones often contain GPS coordinates that reveal exactly where the photo was taken. Sharing such photos publicly can expose your home, workplace, or other sensitive locations.
Removing EXIF data before sharing photos protects your privacy. It also slightly reduces file size since the metadata is no longer included.
en.examplePara: Strip EXIF data by re-saving with Pillow:
en.exampleCode:
from PIL import Image

original = Image.open('photo.jpg')
original.save('clean.jpg')  # EXIF not preserved by default

cn.title: EXIF 移除器 — Coding.Tools
cn.description: 在线移除图片中的 EXIF 元数据以保护隐私。免费，在浏览器中运行。
cn.toolDescription: 从图片中剥离所有 EXIF 元数据，包括 GPS 位置、相机信息和个人数据。
cn.dropzoneHint: 最多 20 张图片 · 每张最大 10MB
descParas: 此工具通过 Canvas API 重新编码图片来移除所有 EXIF 元数据。GPS 坐标、相机信息、时间戳和所有其他元数据都被剥离。
工具完全在浏览器中处理图片，不会将文件上传到服务器。
steps: 将图片拖放到上传区域，或点击选择文件。
每张图片被处理，所有 EXIF 元数据被移除。
下载单个清理后的图片或使用下载全部获取 ZIP 压缩包。
cn.whatIs: 为什么要移除 EXIF 数据？
whatIsParas: 用智能手机拍摄的照片通常包含 GPS 坐标，可以精确显示照片拍摄位置。公开分享此类照片可能暴露您的家、工作场所或其他敏感位置。
在分享照片前移除 EXIF 数据可以保护您的隐私。由于不再包含元数据，文件大小也会略有减小。
cn.examplePara: 通过重新保存来剥离 EXIF 数据：
cn.exampleCode:
from PIL import Image

original = Image.open('photo.jpg')
original.save('clean.jpg')  # 默认不保留 EXIF
